Remark
[totally geodesic hypersurface sphere criterion]

Source: petersen:page-0501 ↗ thm:pet-ch12-quarter-pinched-sphere ↗ def:pet-ch12-alpha-regular 1. ch12:12.8.1Let $(M,g)$ be a closed simply connected positively curved manifold. Show that if $M$ contains a totally geodesic closed hypersurface, then $M$ is homeomorphic to a sphere. (Hint: first show the hypersurface is orientable, then that the signed distance function to it has only two critical points, a maximum and a minimum; this also shows it suffices to assume $H^1(M,\mathbb {Z}_2)=0$.)
